title: Join two actions that share a subject
instructions: Choose the words that correctly complete the sentence.

options.text: finished the safety checklist and handed it
finished the safety checklist, she handed it
finished the safety checklist. And handed it
finished the safety checklist and handing it

choice_rationales.A: The two actions share the subject Rina, so and can join the two verbs without repeating the subject.
choice_rationales.B: A comma alone cannot join two complete clauses, so this makes a comma splice.
choice_rationales.C: The words after the full stop have no subject, so they form a fragment.
choice_rationales.D: Handing does not match finished; both verbs need the same past tense form.

parts.hint: Both actions are done by Rina. Join the two verbs under that one subject.
parts.correct_explanation: “Rina finished the safety checklist and handed it to the coordinator” uses one subject, Rina, with two past tense verbs joined by and.
